column1: # Ledger for b5-charging: one row per original Java expression whose literals left src/.
# B5, the charging domain. Converted: ChargeAlertPolicy's level, watch title, alert titles and alert
# texts (whole templates, no case change); ChargingEstimate's short labels (Result.labelMsg; label keeps
# its English, LOW_CURRENT stays an id and its message is that English verbatim until B13);
# ChargeMeasureWindow's reasons (Decision.message; reason keeps its English for ScooterService's notice
# and logs); BatteryCapacityEstimate's short rejection reasons (shortReasonMsg, Result.reasonMsg;
# shortReason and reason keep their English); the ChargeScheduleController refusals that go straight
# to the caller (setDoneTime, enableDone, setManualEnabled, setManualStart, startTest).
# Not converted, still English and in l10n/baseline/:
# - ChargingEstimate.Result.status (the ETA tooltip and spoken description, DashboardScreen) is built
#   with status += across many branches, and withObservedCurve's caller edits it with replace(): no
#   whole-template structure exists without restructuring the estimator. Deferred to B13 (owner of the
#   dashboard call sites), which also renders labelMsg and maps LOW_CURRENT.
# - ChargeAlertPolicy.watchText (the charge-watch notification's text: "42% now · alert at 80%",
#   "Last seen 42% · alert when full", "Alert at 80%"). Its goal is picked on an earlier line
#   (String goal = target >= 100 ? "alert when full" : "alert at " + target + "%") and upper-cased in
#   code for the no-reading case; whole templates need a choice on that local, which G1 cannot model
#   (README "Still blocked: a helper argument or a choice set on an earlier line"). Alarm text: needs a
#   tooling change before the first language ships (beta bar: no alarm string in fallback).
#   ...): a public String field assigned in the constructor's if-chain and cached by ScooterService, so
#   catalog text there is rendered text kept in a field (R2); it needs a Msg-typed field, which means
#   retyping a public field that DashboardScreen reads (B13). The plan's rejection enum is deferred
#   with it: the long rejection reasons stay English ids (rejectionReasons' keys, counted and compared).
# - ChargeScheduleController: the View's blocked reasons, State.status (shown as View.status), the
#   TestResult failure and cleanup texts, and every refusal of program(), disable(), interrupt(),
#   restoreManualStart() and endTest() (they end up in View, State.status or TestResult, so catalog
#   text there is rendered text kept in a field, R2), including the "Charge done by is off; " and
#   "Scheduled charging is off; " restore texts (the prefix is also chosen at the call site, which G1
#   cannot model as a whole template). These need BlockReason and Consumer<Msg>: the public String
#   fields and Consumer<String> completions are read by MainActivity, QuickAccessGrid and ScooterService,
#   so the API change belongs with those callers (B8, B13, B19) in one change. plan() and
#   nextOccurrence()'s IllegalArgumentException texts are internal (caught, never shown).
# - Kept English on purpose: ChargeMeasureWindow.start's IllegalArgumentException (internal);
#   LearnedRangeEstimate's rejection reasons (ids for replay and diagnostics; screens use its Status
#   enum); ChargeSessionStore (data tier: stored records, its exception texts reach screens through
#   callers' getMessage(), which their batches move to messages); ChargeRecoveryPolicy's exception.
# - No text (reviewed): ChargeScheduleTest, ChargerDetection, ChargeProgressTracker, ChargeReferenceGate,
#   Ut5MaxStockVoltageReference, Ut5MaxFastChargeReference; RangeFollowPolicy has only a ":" key join.
